article.title: New poll upends narrative that Democratic voters are split on El-Sayed
article.author: Michael Arria
article.content: The mainstream media continues to insist Democrats are divided on Israel despite clear evidence to the contrary. Now the media is following the Israel lobby's lead and manufacturing a similar split in Michigan. A new poll shows it's not working.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
